selection_policy: actual LLGM._seeds first occurrence of unique owner; no ranking change
evidence_policy: real Evidence.search with injected retriever over identical tokenizer passages, sources only, no journals

expanded_selection.rule: lowest SHA256(salt + colon + case_id), four non-abstention cases per original question_type, excluding prior pilot

arm_order: case index even: BM25 then ColBERT; odd: ColBERT then BM25; cutoff order alternates similarly
capacity_policy: report gold node count > 3 separately; no-positive/abstention recall is null
claims: Corrected diagnostic comparison after discovering that original LongMemEval session identifiers reveal answer-source membership. Repeat exactly the same 24 expanded cases with opaque source identities; do not select cases from observed retrieval outcomes. All cases remain exposed development inputs in one shared-history component. No held-out generalization, answer accuracy, exact-versus-PLAID effect, or isolated causal estimate of the identifier change is claimed. The separately completed controlled cohort is not rerun under this protocol.
source_identity_requirements: Assign deterministic opaque source IDs without consulting gold annotations; remove original session IDs from retriever-visible source IDs and metadata; preserve source order, dates, roles and full turn text. Keep original-session aliases and evidence labels in evaluator-only records.
